dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (WHO 2022). ... Non-germinal-center (Hans) phenotype: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in about 70% of tumor cells.

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell-of-origin by gene expression and MYD88, CD79B and TP53 genotyping have not been done.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV-B with bulky disease (X). ... I score the splenic lesions as extranodal, giving stage IV. Lugano would count the spleen as a lymphoid (nodal) site, giving stage III; treatment is the same either way.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: Lugano would count the spleen as a lymphoid (nodal) site, giving stage III; treatment is the same either way.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: retroperitoneal conglomerate 11.0 x 8.1 cm (bulky, 10 cm or more) ... B symptoms present: fever to 38.3-38.5 C several nights a week and drenching night sweats.

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV-B with bulky disease (X). ... I score the splenic lesions as extranodal, giving stage IV.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III-IV, LDH above ULN; ECOG 1 and one extranodal site score zero)

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by IHC (MYC 50% and BCL2 80% of tumor cells, both above the usual 40% and 50% cut-offs). FISH negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma (not HGBL with MYC and BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangements).

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor by IHC (MYC 50% and BCL2 80% of tumor cells, both above the usual 40% and 50% cut-offs).

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III-IV, LDH above ULN; ECOG 1 and one extranodal site score zero), which is high-intermediate.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI about 3 of 5: age over 60 (1), stage III-IV (1), LDH above ULN (1); kidney or adrenal involvement absent on PET (0); only one extranodal site (0).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles of 21 days: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1 (about 140 mg at 78 kg), rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1

tx_pola_preferred.quote: IPI 3 with bulk, B symptoms and splenic involvement is the high-risk setting where POLARIX showed a PFS benefit (IPI 2-5 enrolled)... Fallback is R-CHOP-21 x 6 if polatuzumab is unavailable

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Residual uptake at Deauville 4-5 in the retroperitoneal mass: consolidative RT to about 30-36 Gy, or biopsy first if the residual mass is growing.

mn_non_curative.quote: Goal is cure and he has said so; I will frame the plan as curative intent

mn_da_epoch.quote: Not DA-EPOCH-R, which is reserved for true double-hit disease, which he does not have, and not R-EPOCH on double expression alone.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: Fit for full-dose immunochemotherapy. Age 62, ECOG 1, independent in all self-care, normal renal and hepatic function

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: HBV: HBsAg nonreactive, anti-HBc reactive, anti-HBs reactive (resolved infection, high risk of reactivation with rituximab). Send quantitative HBV DNA and ALT now. Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) now, before the first rituximab dose, and continue for at least 12 months after the last rituximab

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Send quantitative HBV DNA and ALT now. ... Check ALT and HBV DNA every 3 months during treatment and 12 months after.

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: Start cycle 1 only after HBV prophylaxis is started

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) and no baseline lumbar puncture or brain MRI, because his neuro exam is non-focal and he has no CNS symptoms.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate)

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET about 3-4 weeks after cycle 6 (around late March 2027). Decisions at end of treatment: Deauville 1-3 (or 4 with reduced uptake and no residual mass) is complete metabolic response, no RT.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Residual uptake at Deauville 4-5 in the retroperitoneal mass: consolidative RT to about 30-36 Gy, or biopsy first if the residual mass is growing.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis: intermediate risk (bulk 11 cm, LDH 3 times ULN, Ki-67 85%, uric acid 7.1). Start allopurinol 300 mg daily now and hydrate; check K, phosphate, creatinine and uric acid at baseline and on days 1-3.

sup_gcsf.quote: Myeloid growth factor: primary pegfilgrastim (or biosimilar) on day 4 of every cycle (or on-body injector), because age over 60, advanced stage, bulk and B symptoms put FN risk high enough to justify it.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: echo 2026-09-08 with LVEF 58% and GLS -20% is adequate for doxorubicin, no repeat unless symptoms.

fit_full_dose.quote: Fit for full-dose immunochemotherapy. Age 62, ECOG 1, independent in all self-care, normal renal and hepatic function, LVEF 58%, and few comorbidities (hypothyroidism, GERD and hyperlipidemia, all controlled).

miss_hbv_dna.quote: HBV DNA quantitative level (not done; HBsAg negative, anti-HBc and anti-HBs reactive).
